        # Positive update, stronger when recipient has low reputation (rehabilitation) and weaker when high
        delta = 0.6 * (1.0 - recipient_rep) * (1.0 + current_reputation) / 2.0
    else:
        # Negative update, stronger when recipient has high reputation (betrayal) and weaker when low
        delta = -0.7 * (1.0 + recipient_rep) * (1.0 - current_reputation) / 2.0
